texts.value: Transcriptional coactivator which enhances the transcriptional activities of several nuclear receptors including ESR1, THRB, PPARG and RARA (PubMed:11971969). Inhibits the activity of the vacuolar-type ATPase (V-ATPase) by inducing disassembly of the V-ATPase complex (PubMed:38593795). Protects the Golgi apparatus lumen from excess acidification by inhibiting V-ATPase ATP hydrolytic activity through interaction with V-ATPase catalytic subunit ATP6V1A, maintaining optimal conditions for glycosylation enzymes (By similarity). Required to stabilize V-ATPase V1 subunits ATP6V1B2 and ATP6V1A at membrane sites (By similarity). Involved in protection against oxidative damage (PubMed:17391516, PubMed:25330068). Involved in urine acidification (By similarity)
Exhibits oxidation resistance activity (PubMed:25330068). Protects neuronal cells from oxidative stress with weaker neuroprotective activity than isoform 5 (By similarity)

Exhibits oxidation resistance activity (PubMed:25330068). Protects neuronal cells from oxidative stress with stronger neuroprotective activity than isoform 1 (By similarity). Inhibits endosome-mediated viral entry by inhibiting fusion of the viral and endosomal membranes and subsequent nuclear translocation of viral ribonucleoproteins (PubMed:30478388). Promotes increased cytoplasmic vesicular acidification, lysosomal protease activity and the degradation of endocytosed material (PubMed:30478388)

Interacts with ESR1, ESR2A, ESR2B, THRB, PPARG and RARA in a ligand-inducible manner (PubMed:11971969). Interacts with the heterodimer AHR-ARNT (PubMed:10395741). Interacts (via TLDc domain) with V-ATPase subunit ATP6V1A; the interaction leads to inhibition of V-ATPase ATP hydrolytic activity (By similarity). Interacts (via TLDc domain) with vacuolar ATPase subunit ATP6V1B1 (By similarity). Interacts with vacuolar ATPase subunits ATP6V1B2 and ATP6V1C (By similarity). Interacts with a number of GTP-bound Rab proteins including RAB1A, RAB6A, RAB8A, RAB10, RAB11A, RAB19B, RAB39A and RAB43; recruitment to the Golgi and trans-Golgi membranes is dependent on binding to GTP-bound Rab proteins (By similarity)
Interacts with vacuolar ATPase subunits ATP6V1A, ATP6V1B2, ATP6V1E1 and ATP6V1G2

Predominantly nuclear following estradiol stimulation (PubMed:17391516). Localizes to the nucleus and cytoplasm in the absence of estradiol (PubMed:17391516). Recruited to the cis-Golgi network and trans-Golgi network membranes in a Rab-dependent manner (By similarity)
Highly expressed in brain. Weakly expressed in mammary gland, ovary, uterus, prostate, stomach, bladder, spinal cord and pancreas. Expressed in cancer cell line
Constitutively expressed. Not induced by hydrogen peroxide
Induced by interferon IFNB1 (PubMed:25330068). Induced by lipopolysaccharide (PubMed:25330068). Not induced by hydrogen peroxide (PubMed:25330068)
The TLDc domain is sufficient to confer protection against oxidative stress
